Subject: Draft MAP & evidence asks for CardinalHS MSA/DPA

Hi Ellen / Marcus —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discussion, I put together a short mutual action plan and a list of evidence artifacts to keep procurement and legal moving in parallel. Goal: keep signature velocity high while giving your legal team what they need so we don’t hit a last-minute DPA hold.

Short MAP (owners + target dates):
- Procurement kickoff sign-off: CardinalHS procurement (Marcus) — target: 2027-06-01
- Security evidence review (SOC2 summary + questionnaire answers): Monica Patel — target: 2027-06-03
- Legal redline pass (MSA/DPA): Karthik Iyer (Redwood) + Cardinal legal — target: 2027-06-04
- Order form finalization & DocuSign prep: Naomi Feldman — target: 2027-06-06
- Expected signature window: 2027-06-07 to 2027-06-09

Evidence collector (stubs attached): soc2-summary-2027Q1.pdf (short summary), redlines-markup-msadpa.docx (we will circulate annotated MSA/DPA), map-owner-calendar-v1.xlsx (timeline + owner matrix).

Questions / asks for your side: please confirm whether CardinalHS legal requires additional privacy artifacts (DPIA or data flow diagrams) and whether you need an escrow or on-premise language in the DPA. If legal requests SLA exceptions, flag them early — we can discuss commercial/operational mitigations rather than blocking signature.

If that MAP looks good I’ll circulate an updated calendar invite and open a DocuSign envelope for the order form once redlines are agreed.

Thanks —
Naomi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.f@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cardinalhs.com>

Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@cardinalhs.com>, procurement@cardinalhs.com
Date: 2027-05-31T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & evidence asks for CardinalHS MSA/DPA

Thanks Naomi — this is helpful. Couple notes from procurement/legal: 

1) Timeline constraints: procurement needs final SOW/order form by 2027-06-06 to route for our internal PO cycle. If the DPA is still in flight after that date, procurement will accept signature of the order form with an MSA execution SLA (i.e., order form signature then DPA to follow within 14 days).

2) Evidence requests: SOC2 summary is fine as a start; our security team will want the full SOC2 Type II report if any redlines touch data residency/audit. Please have Monica confirm availability.

3) Legal review: We typically complete an initial redline pass in 3 business days. If Redwood can provide an annotated MSA/DPA that documents changes and rationale, that will speed our review.

4) Escalation triggers: any request for termination-for-convenience changes or broad indemnity expansion will trigger an executive legal review and may push the timeline.

I’ll ask our legal lead to review the redlines but planning note: if we need an SLA exception (e.g., lower uptime SLA or specific data retention carve-outs), our InfoSec & Legal leads will need to keep parallel conversations.

Best,
Ellen
Head of Procurement | Cardinal Health Solutions
ellen.park@cardinalhs.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cardinalhs.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@cardinalhs.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: action items from CardinalHS — owners & contingency

Team — quick sync after Ellen’s note. Key asks and proposed owners: 

- Monica: confirm if we can provide the full SOC2 Type II report (redacted) by 2027-06-03. If not available, provide a SOC2 bridge memo and a plan for the full report delivery. Attachment: soc2-summary-2027Q1.pdf (stub).
- Karthik: prepare annotated redlines on the MSA/DPA and call out any clauses that are likely to trigger Cardinal exec review (indemnity, termination, data residency, SLA exceptions). Target first pass to Cardinal by 2027-06-02 end-of-day. Attachment: redlines-markup-msadpa.docx (stub).
- Laura: own acceptance criteria for pilot and confirm order form billing/term language to avoid rework. Target: 2027-06-04.
- Naomi (me): prep DocuSign envelope and prepare two signature tracks: (A) order form only (fast path) and (B) MSA+DPA simultaneous (preferred).

Contingency: if DPA review extends beyond 2027-06-06, we will propose "order form now / DPA within 14 days" path to procurement. Karthik — please note any redline risk that would block an order-form-only signature.

I’ll parallelize these owners and we’ll keep Ellen/Marcus in the loop.

Thanks —
Naomi

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-01T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: action items from CardinalHS — owners & contingency

Thanks — I’ll take the legal lane. Quick notes: 

- I’ll produce an annotated redline pack by end-of-day 2027-06-02. That will include an issues register with severity (green/amber/red) and suggested language.
- High-risk clauses to watch: indemnity cap and carve-outs for regulatory claims; data residency & cross-border transfer clauses in the DPA; termination-for-convenience notice periods. Any major changes there will likely trigger an executive escalation.
- If Cardinal insists on bespoke SLA wording we can discuss commercial offsets (e.g., extended support credits or a short-term SLA exception for pilot). Please confirm whether our default support SLA (99.5% uptime monthly) is acceptable.
- I'll prepare a DocuSign-ready redline for the order form (clean order form + annotated MSA/DPA) so procurement can sign the order form fast while legal completes the DPA.

Forwarding Ellen’s request to our legal ops contact for sequencing.

-Karthik

Ellen / Marcus — thank you for the clarity on procurement windows. Confirming the MAP and next steps below so we have a single source of truth.

Agreed MAP (owners / dates):
- 2027-06-03: Monica to deliver SOC2 bridge memo or full report (soc2-summary-2027Q1.pdf attached).
- 2027-06-02 (EOD): Karthik to send annotated redlines and issues register (redlines-markup-msadpa.docx attached).

Escalation triggers (if any occur):
